t: On there being people who do this work
a: وَلْتَكُن مِّنكُمْ أُمَّةٌ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْخَيْرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
p: Wa-l-takun minkum ummatun yadʿūna ila-l-khayri wa ya'murūna bi-l-maʿrūfi wa yanhawna ʿani-l-munkar…
m: And let there be [arising] from you a nation inviting to [all that is] good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and those will be the successful.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
